gen-gf-grandstander-gf-tiktok-sans: Chunky and playful, Grandstander keeps its diagonals as heavy as its uprights, while TikTok Sans lifts its lowercase nearly to cap height. Its quality is plain, friendly punch.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-pt-sans-caption: Gugi draws every curve with one constant stroke, its lowercase nearly touching the capitals. PT Sans Caption follows with big, inviting bowls that keep a long page of text feeling open and easy going.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Menacing, mostly. Eater thins its curves just slightly and spaces its letters wide, whereas Noto Sans Palmyrene is the tidy counterweight, with curves that stop short of closing and ascenders kept compact.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-psalter-pahlavi: Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi has gaping, friendly e shapes and capitals that barely rise above the lowercase, which gives it an approachable ease. Flavors is the showman, with towering, heavy-diagonal letters.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Wire-like, tubular letters define Audiowide, with no thick-to-thin shift anywhere in its curves and tiles of glyphs spaced wide. And Noto Sans Balinese gives each curve breathing room, so its size can be kept modest.
gen-almendra-display-gf-montserrat-alter: Montserrat Alternates skims along with a wide-open c and round letters. Almendra Display adds ornate, literary character above, and a longer passage would still move with a light, unhurried ease.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-yaldevi: Yaldevi sets oversized lowercase with an e that opens clearly to the right, giving each word generous presence. And Funnel Display, cut like laser-traced spaghetti, lets a long page read in smooth, open lines.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-questrial: Questrial reads flat and stencil-cut, with open round shapes and a tall band of lowercase under short stalks. Autour One matches that single-weight feel up top, so both fit together smoothly.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-puritan: Wide, confident, and a bit rounded off. Goldman spreads its big-lowercase letters with plenty of clearance, while Puritan keeps its oversized e and a counters open. Their strongest trait is easygoing boldness.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-radio-canada: Radio Canada stands its c, s and z tall and full, with a steady line and a clear opening at every curve end. A long page would glide along without any snag.
